Einstein didn't say he was smarter. He said he stayed longer.

Kevin Trudeau asks you to picture a mountain. Can you change it or not? If you can't, don't resist it. If you can, find the courage.

He shares Einstein's line: it's not that I'm so smart, it's that I stay with problems longer, working towards solutions.

That's keeping your eye on the dream, and embracing the challenge instead of fearing it.

Which problem could you stay with a little longer?
